excerpts.content:
the new fields supported are:
```
env.currentGasTarget
env.currentBaseFee
tx.tip
tx.maxPriorityFeePerGas (alias for tx.tip)
tx.feeCap
tx.maxFeePerGas (alias for tx.feeCap)
```
